Resolved native request. All byte spans and radio are borrowed during create. Native creation never changes mixer settings. It reads tuning EEPROM only when shared source configuration explicitly enables it. Each stopped-to-started transition applies selected gains and valid EEPROM tuning before GPIO or audio starts; omitted controls and all switches are preserved. Radio generation/frame bounds/publication cadence are set by native lifecycle; effective released ABI-5 radio settings are otherwise preserved. Inactive signaling fields are normalized by the typed radio configuration.
